title: Reclamation: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Reclamation loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Start with the seeds and soil treatments you can sustain. Keep early plots small, lit, and close to storage so crop failures do not become expedition failures.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first success is not a large farm. It is a small lit plot, a repeatable food source, and a seed reserve that survives one failed expedition.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Reclamation is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: First Checkpoint
blocks.body: Use this as the first concrete checkpoint before the route gets wider.
blocks.label: Wheat
